A.name: global whole-game proper-score stacking
A.fit: One scalar role mass w in[0,1]; minimise average training-game composite exact mixture CRPS over N/R with bounded scalar optimisation xatol1e-12; one configuration.
A.objective: 0.5*mean playerPTS CRPS/3 +0.25*mean criticalPTS CRPS/4 +0.25*mean teamPTS CRPS/6; critical prior_usage>=.25; games without critical players use all-player PTS in that term. No current-outcome feature.

B.name: dated team-context expert selection
B.fit: Shared logistic team gate with intercept and3 features: max prior_usage, mean log1p(n_history), mean absolute difference native/role forecast minute means. Training-only scaler, sd1 if constant. Independent home/away expert draws give masses[(1-h)(1-a),h(1-a),(1-h)a,ha] over N/H/V/R. Minimise same training composite CRPS +.1/2*sum(slopes²), intercept unpenalised; L-BFGS-B maxiter500,ftol1e-12,gtol1e-7,maxls40; zero slopes/intercept0 start; no alternate configuration.

C.name: player reliability gate followed by constrained event generation
C.fit: Logistic classification of whether R assigns lower playerPTS CRPS than N on41training games. Features prior_usage,log1p(n_history),absolute native/role minute-mean disagreement; training-only scaler; intercept unpenalised,l2=.1 slopes. L-BFGS-B same500/ftol/gtol/maxls. At generation sample independent per-player Bernoulli gates, choose native/role predicted minute draws, bounded240 projection, balanced-second quantisation and shared exact decoder; all points emerge from events. One configuration.
